checks.http: PASS Pages-style base, share image, notices, robots, sitemap and 404 from built artifact
checks.responsive: PASS zh-Hant/en at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 CSS px, 200% text size, touch and no shader in reduced motion
checks.fallback: PASS no-JS HTML, unsupported WebGPU and rejected adapter with working CSS controls
checks.paperCommercial: PASS bilingual series prefill and suggestions, preserved custom choices, specifications, units, touch, validation, keyboard focus, edit, and exact local download with privacy
checks.shaderTexture: PASS real WebGPU texture has nonuniform pixels
checks.compositing: PASS visible canvas changes with controls
checks.pause: PASS three pause/resume cycles without extra devices or texture acquisition while paused
checks.deviceRecovery: PASS new WebGPU device after injected unknown loss and actual old device destruction
checks.visibility: PASS no frame acquisition during injected hidden state and actual offscreen scroll
checks.webgpu: PASS nonuniform WebGPU pixels, live input changes, recovery after injected unknown-loss signal and actual device destruction, pause/resume, hidden event, offscreen, return
checks.privacy: PASS only static same-origin GETs, no fetch/XHR/beacon/socket, CSP violations, browser errors, cookies or storage
checks.paperMaterial: PASS two viewports, full natural cycle, five lamp angles, same-frame pause and resume
checks.signalBooking: PASS both locales: pass and set selection, empty/invalid quantity, pricing, retained set when browsing, opening/admission times, keyboard review/edit, local UTF-8 itinerary download, no purchase or reservation
checks.signalMotion: PASS natural desktop and mobile cycles for all three programs, three in-place transitions, and stable original-resolution stage pixels and zero extra presentation frames during native pause on desktop and mobile
checks.signal: PASS bilingual 320/390/768/1440 and 200% text layout, keyboard/touch, synchronized hero previews and lineup, three visible WebGPU programs, 18 switches on one device, lifecycle and recovery, no-GPU/no-JS/reduced motion and privacy
checks.compositeControls: PASS non-evolving desktop A/A/B/A control checks and all same-frame pauses. Evolving particle differences are equal-window diagnostics requiring separate same-SHA non-author three-form review. Supplemental mobile checks actual evolution before/after pause, zero paused submissions and canvas-hide diagnostic; dedicated lanes cover mobile forms and natural sequences. Only pauseMode=freeze qualifies for M03 freeze acceptance.
